description: Gujarat HC has issued a policy on AI use in judiciary, stating it cannot be used for judicial decision-making. Check guidelines and key observations.
body_lead: HOLDING THAT human judgement, guided by “conscience, reason, law, and constitutional values, must remain inviolate” in the delivery of impartial justice, the Gujarat High Court on Saturday released a ‘Policy On Use Of Artificial Intelligence In Judicial and Court Administration’, laying down the areas where Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be deployed as well as the restriction on its use – especially in decision making, adjudication, judgments and reasoning.
